component_content.title: Enhancing Collaboration and Communication through Peer Feedback

content.title: Understanding the Concept of Peer Feedback
content.content:
A peer feedback session is an opportunity for students to give and receive constructive feedback on their work from their peers. It's an essential tool for learning, growth, and improvement.

During a peer feedback session, participants share their work, provide feedback, and engage in discussions to clarify any doubts or concerns.

Peer feedback sessions foster collaboration, communication, and mutual respect among group members.

Key benefits include:

  • Improved understanding of assignments
  • Enhanced critical thinking skills
  • Development of effective communication strategies
  • Fostered teamwork and collaboration

By participating in peer feedback sessions, you'll gain valuable experience in giving and receiving constructive feedback, which is a crucial skill for academic success.
